source.workingTree: dirty; findings inspect current working files, including uncommitted event bridge, label, notification, task, work-item, view, workspace, and audit edits
source.method: Source and test-assertion inspection only. No build, test, browser, database, or network operation was executed in this audit.
source.auditBaseline: docs/report/audit/audit-P0.json EV-1, EV-2, EV-5 currentAssessment; older evidence and gap strings are historical, not executable proof

scopeBoundary.compatibility: 25 October approved strict task bridge uses task.id as taskId and key; task.updated is the single parent for multi-field edits; task.moved is the single parent for compound moves. These are separate from native EVENT_KEYS and may not enter native webhook or automation subscriptions.
scopeBoundary.inactive: task.deleted has no reachable producer because DELETE /api/task/{id} returns 410; task-relation.refresh and notification.created are disposable cache/realtime signals, not semantic domain events; startup column normalization has no synthetic event.
scopeBoundary.plugins: The inherited plugin registry has no registration call in shipped API source. Its legacy broadcast subscribers are therefore not a current integration delivery obligation; removed integration routers stay removed. This does not exempt durable event producers or notification rows that are reachable now.

producerMatrix.producer: native work-item create, update, move, assign, unassign, transition, comment/mention, delete
producerMatrix.status: transactional parent and eligible canonical notification candidates in inspected paths
producerMatrix.childrenAndReplay: recordWorkItemEvent uses enqueueNotificationEvent or bare enqueueOutboxEvent, once; fanout writes inbox and delivery children under the caller tx. Parent consumer uses a claim/savepoint and native webhook/automation enqueue by event id. No execution claim for the full producer matrix.

Optional inherited assignee inbox row is in the transaction via insertLegacyTaskNotification, but is not event-id-linked and has no canonical notification_delivery child. Post-commit publishEvent is only an in-memory hint/plugin call.

producerMatrix.producer: legacy task single-field status, title, description, priority, due date, assignee
producerMatrix.status: compatibility parent in mutation transaction on change
producerMatrix.childrenAndReplay: Required legacy activity and eligible legacy inbox are written in transaction where applicable; inbox lacks parent event id and child delivery. Status no-op parent absence and rollback on outbox failure have focused PostgreSQL assertions, not universal execution proof.

producerMatrix.producer: legacy task multi-field update, compound move, bulk item operations
producerMatrix.status: compatibility parent per changed task transaction; multi-field and move vocabulary follows approved bridge
producerMatrix.childrenAndReplay: The post-commit EventEmitter publishes extra specific hints for a multi-field update; those are not additional durable parents by approved design. Bulk operations have item transactions and must be verified for each operation/no-op/failure branch; current focused bridge suite does not assert them all.

producerMatrix.producer: task-scoped label create, assign, unassign, delete and workspace-label cascade copies
producerMatrix.status: compatibility parents inside task-label and cascade transactions for emitted task effects
producerMatrix.childrenAndReplay: No notification audience is declared for these compatibility keys. Workspace catalogue-only create/rename has no published task.label_* event; do not fabricate a legacy task id. Label test filenames alone do not prove all cascade/replay branches.

producerMatrix.producer: legacy comment create and edit through activity/comment aliases
producerMatrix.status: source gap: transaction commits before only in-memory publish; no outbox parent
producerMatrix.childrenAndReplay: Create mention and assignee notifications run after commit through createNotification and have no event id or child; interruption can lose them and replay cannot reconstruct them. Comment publisher includes name and raw comment text, requiring explicit customer-safe projection at any future delivery boundary.

producerMatrix.status: no declared domain event currently emitted; not evidence for EV-1 event coverage
producerMatrix.childrenAndReplay: The activity row itself commits in a transaction. It has no event or event-derived notification candidate. Do not invent a compatibility key.

producerMatrix.status: source gap on create: transaction commits before only in-memory event; update has no published event
producerMatrix.childrenAndReplay: Optional create inbox is atomic with the time entry via insertLegacyTaskNotification, but no parent id or notification_delivery child links it; the published create event is not replayable. Update is outside declared event vocabulary.

producerMatrix.status: transactional native parent and owner inbox
producerMatrix.childrenAndReplay: Owner recipient is resolved and materialized before commit; no external subscription is presumed on creation. Other workspace membership/role changes have no keys in this event catalogue and are not evidence of a missing workspace.created event.

producerMatrix.producer: saved-view create, update, pin, approved delete
producerMatrix.status: transactional native parents; old blanket in-memory-only audit wording is stale
producerMatrix.childrenAndReplay: After-commit publishEvent is a hint. These keys declare no notification audience. Approved deletion writes saved_view.deleted in the same transaction as the delete and pending-action outcome parents.

producerMatrix.producer: project/workspace catalogue-label removal that clears canonical work-item labels
producerMatrix.status: transactional native parent per affected canonical work item
producerMatrix.childrenAndReplay: Affected canonical work items get internal label-change envelopes. A catalogue row's standalone create/rename has no declared label lifecycle event; do not invent one.

producerMatrix.status: source gap: mutation transaction commits before in-memory event
producerMatrix.childrenAndReplay: No target-model relation key or notification audience is declared; requires an explicitly registered compatibility approach, not a fabricated native work_item event.
No notification audience declared; native parent consumer idempotency rules apply.

crossCuttingFindings.finding: Legacy task/time-entry notification helper inserts an inbox row in the mutation transaction, but omits event_id, person_id and kind; there is no notification_delivery child linked to the parent. Transactionality alone does not satisfy EV-1's event-derived child and digest clauses.

The compatibility parent can be drained once, but legacy inbox rows are not keyed by parent event id. No event-id unique constraint or replay materializer protects these child effects; current test asserts an existing row stays unchanged after a no-op drain, a narrower property than EV-2 universal replay idempotency.

Canonical notification fanout has current customer audience/reach and safe generic comment projections, but webhook work_item.updated projection accepts missing or unknown changes[].visibility because it drops only the exact value internal. EV-5/NO-19 requires fail-closed filtering for internal or unclassified change entries. The webhook recipient is a workspace subscription, so this is an external projection weakness rather than proof of a current customer notification leak.

The legacy comment publisher carries raw content and a staff display name; legacy comment notifications contain commenter/mentioner names and a comment preview. Current legacy task notification reach predicate is staff-scoped, but this audit did not execute a customer/agent/portal/revocation matrix. Future replay or customer-facing projection must not copy those raw values. Do not equate no active inherited plugin with a universal EV-5 pass.

staleAuditWording.claim: No attachDigest implementation, no digest membership
staleAuditWording.correction: attachDigestWindow exists and is the fanout default for enabled nonurgent external channels; this does not cure missing legacy child linkage.

staleAuditWording.claim: No parent outbox consumer or webhook/automation replay
staleAuditWording.correction: Built-in native consumers are registered on default drain; parent claim runs handlers in a savepoint and marks delivered only after success. Compatibility keys are deliberately excluded from webhook/automation consumers.

staleAuditWording.claim: All legacy task/label/view/workspace events are solely fire-and-forget
staleAuditWording.correction: Task and task-label compatibility parents, saved-view parents, and workspace.created are transactional in inspected source. Comment, time-entry and relation publish paths remain uncovered.

evidenceLimits.knownExecutedOutsideThisAudit: Coordinator reports focused legacy bridge 4 PostgreSQL and 6 unit assertions, plus 11 label unit assertions. Their exact commands/results were not reproduced by this audit.
evidenceLimits.pending: Full final local suite, affected browser journeys on persisted data, universal producer/no-op/failure/replay assertions, customer projection/revocation matrix, and formal end-of-phase independent review. No phase verdict or Thomas acceptance is inferred.
